confirmed_bugs.title: Observed EB-TASK-DELETE deviation
confirmed_bugs.expected: After successful deletion, the selected task is absent immediately, after page refresh, and after leaving and reopening the Tasks view.

confirmed_bugs.title: Observed EB-PROJECT-SUBMIT deviation
confirmed_bugs.expected: Repeated submission of the same in-flight project-create operation creates one project. Two intentional completed submissions are separate operations and may create two projects.
